title: HELIX Customization Register
description: One row per difference between a vanilla PeopleSoft, Banner, or Colleague installation and production. Produced by tools/diff_customizations.py, then enriched and decided by people. The CSV template has the same columns.

customization_id.description: PS-00001, BN-00001, CL-00001. Assigned by the diff tool.

source_release.description: Application and tools release the baseline was built at, for example 'CS 9.2 PUM 35 / PeopleTools 8.61' or 'Banner Student 9.x'.

object_type.description: RECORD, RECORD_FIELD, PEOPLECODE, APP_ENGINE, SQL_OBJECT, QUERY, PROCESS, IB_ROUTING, XLAT_VALUE, PACKAGE BODY, PROCEDURE, TRIGGER, VIEW, TABLE_COLUMN, JOB, VALIDATION_CODE, DB_LINK, EXTERNAL_CALL, SQR, COBOL, and others.

sub_key.description: Part of the object: field on a record, PeopleCode event path, trigger's table, validation code value, relative folder for files.

change_type.description: added: not in vanilla. modified: in vanilla but different. removed: in vanilla, missing in production.

usage_runs_12mo.description: Runs in the last 12 months from process scheduler, job submission, or query statistics. Blank means no evidence, not zero.

local_name_flag.description: Name follows the site's local prefix convention (Banner: usually Z).

functional_area.description: Registrar, Financial Aid, Bursar, HR, Payroll, Finance, Advancement, Admissions, IT, and so on.

business_owner.description: The person who can say whether it's still needed. Required before a disposition other than retire is approved.

helix_resources_touched.description: Semicolon-separated HELIX Core resources the object reads or writes, found through the bridge mappings. Example: Student;Hold;Enrollment

target_platform.description: workday, banner_saas, aurora_postgresql, rds_postgresql, redshift, helix_lakehouse, none.

target_object.description: What it becomes: a dbt model, a Glue job, a Workday business process condition, an Ethos integration, a crosswalk row, and so on.
